definitions.explanation: A reference book that systematically explains the grammar rules of a language. Used by learners and specialists alike.

examples.japanese: ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文法書|ぶんぽうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought an English grammar book.

examples.japanese: わからない{時|とき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文法書|ぶんぽうしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: When I don't understand something, I look it up in a grammar book.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{文法書|ぶんぽうしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{例文|れいぶん}→例文：19450_reibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすい。
examples.english: This grammar book has many example sentences and is easy even for beginners.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{文法|ぶんぽう}→文法：01506_bunpou⟧ (grammar) + ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (book, writing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文法書|ぶんぽうしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to look something up in a grammar book
- {文法書|ぶんぽうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open a grammar book

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{参考書|さんこうしょ}→参考書：05142_sankousho⟧: study reference book — broader, covers any subject
- ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧: dictionary — for words and meanings, not grammar rules
